There seems to be no one here, but if the party investigates too closely, a @UUID[Actor.TRcwwntLPqt7KaJy]{Mutated Beastman} surprises them from behind.

A @UUID[Actor.ri94quNUXFjXfjI3]{Beastman} has fallen foul of the ravages of Chaos and become a @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.7GvkaaVAd69ORno0]{Chaos Spawn}. This creature bleats and screams as it passes through the tunnels, so the party should be able to avoid its path. It has no eyes, but if it hears them, it pursues relentlessly and attacks.

A group of @UUID[Actor.ri94quNUXFjXfjI3]{Beastmen} (a number equal to party size) led by a @UUID[Actor.TRcwwntLPqt7KaJy]{Mutated Beastman} carrying a flaming torch patrols the tunnels. They are looking for intruders, and if any of the Beastmen detect the party, the entire patrol attacks at once.

@UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-voll-journals.JournalEntry.0sTvCVRuh5Wpawt9]{The Eye of Voll}- Industrial action in planetary region Gamma-74 threatens to delay Rokarth’s tithe contributions. Some say this is the work of a mysterious cult leader who seeks to challenge the status quo.

@UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-voll-journals.JournalEntry.0sTvCVRuh5Wpawt9]{The Eye of Voll}- There is a healer out in the wastes to the west that can heal any injury. Some believe he is an Imperial Saint, blessed by the God-Emperor.

@UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-voll-journals.JournalEntry.DSccO5miF7LSJCVS]{Illicit Fabrications}- The Adeptus Mechanicus deem the destruction of a manufactorum in the lower hive unsatisfactory. Its output supplied Rokarth's nobility with key rejuvenat reagents and was an invaluable asset to Mechanicus sovereignty on Voll. The disappearance of the primary Tech-Priest overseer is also deemed sub optimal.

@UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-voll-journals.JournalEntry.DSccO5miF7LSJCVS]{Illicit Fabrications}- Citizens are mourning in the wake of Manufactorum Vitus-II’s sudden destruction. Moreover, they’re starting to report sightings of mutants lurking around the area.

@UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-voll-journals.JournalEntry.yAAIQKv8lK49HRLz]{Implacable}- A wave of murders threatens the Halion’s Triumph celebrations. Whoever is in charge is facing concerns that the hive-wide festivities should be postponed until these murders are solved.

@UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-voll-journals.JournalEntry.yAAIQKv8lK49HRLz]{Implacable}- A rapidly growing death cult known as the Vertexis is quickly gaining power and popularity. People think they are building towards something sinister, and the clock is ticking.

@UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-voll-journals.JournalEntry.QbQ7dTzbEVJyBLXJ]{Interminable Devotion}- A wayward scion of House Nethecaré has been missing for some time, yet the noble house only became aware of their absence because of the resources this person stole.

@UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-voll-journals.JournalEntry.QbQ7dTzbEVJyBLXJ]{Interminable Devotion}- Some speak of an ancient Capitol Imperialis rumbling across Voll’s wastes, under the sway of House Nethecaré. To lay your eyes upon this super-heavy tank is a sight to behold.

@UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-voll-journals.JournalEntry.mOfAsI4kLKUGTLXd]{Paradigm Shift}- Sharks are circling one Lord Felputh. He is behind on tithe fulfilments, and has holdings over rejuvenat chemicals crucial to the extended lives of the highborn of Rokarth.

@UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-voll-journals.JournalEntry.mOfAsI4kLKUGTLXd]{Paradigm Shift}- Another manufactorum up in flames! A few locals in surrounding districts report that some of their friends and family have gone missing.
‘A voice calls your name, and each time it repeats, it sounds deeper, wetter, and less human.’
‘The barking laughter of a dozen voices seems to come from inside a nearby wall.’
‘You hear a child’s voice call out to you from a nearby drain, saying ‘Help me’.’
‘Scratching seems to follow you, like the sound of clawed fingers raking repeatedly across rusted deck plates.’
‘A wet slithering sound, like something smooth wriggling through mud, terminates in an echo of inhuman footsteps.’
‘A faint babbling seems to intermingle with the sound of running water, soon you realise it’s not babbling, it’s weeping.’
‘A loud thumping noise catches your attention from somewhere far off, gradually building faster and faster.’
‘You hear a whispered voice repeating the same phrase, it takes you a moment to realise it's saying… ‘Soon they’ll know’.’
‘A scream cuts through the air raw and blood curdling, echoing out around you in a cacophony of suffering.’
‘Heavy footsteps thunder like heavy cannon fire, slowly drawing closer and closer until they seem all around you.’

A Skitarii patrol blocks the path ahead, dragging citizens aside to question. The party may attempt to endure the repetitive questioning, negotiate their way past, or scale a series of rusty containers to avoid the oncoming patrol. This requires characters to make a Challenging (+0) Athletics (Climbing) Test. Failure alerts the Skitarii patrol, who are now suspicious of the party.

The ever-present smog that casts the hab slums in a hazy yellow light briefly parts, allowing the party to see a patrol of Skitarii Vanguard ahead, about to burst into a squat, ramshackle dwelling. The party may shout a warning to those within, diverting the Skitarii’s attention, or allow events to unfold as they will.

Four @UUID[Actor.jSJkugzVGrfqbl9o]{Skitarii Vanguard} prepare to execute Malak Dross, a well-known local Infractionist, for refusing to give up the location of the missing Tech-Priest. He professes not to know what they are talking about. Arguing for Dross’s life requires a Challenging (+0) Rapport (Charm) or Logic (Investigation) Test, with success granting the characters a new Infractionist @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.qxkAEAcB9xAl56Xa#personal-influence]{Contact}. Dross knows nothing about the missing Tech-Priest, but is a valuable guide to the Lower Hive hab slums.

A few inebriated @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.qBvBctGcZoWcW7Tz]{Manufactorum Labourers} have gathered outside an illicit bar, heedless of the Skitarii's presence. They demand a few solars each from the characters, but back down if a character passes a Challenging (+0) Presence (Intimidation) or Rapport (Charm) Test.

Noxious gases pool like acrid smoke over a pond of greasy water. It’s clear from the ad-hoc collection of pipes and containers that the pool is used as a local water supply. Ignorant and unheeding of the patrols, Agala, an elderly blind woman, uses a hooked pole to drag detritus from the questionable water. Despite her ailment, she can easily direct the characters anywhere in the hab slums. She assumes the slums, especially the ‘lagoon’ she tends, are the most beautiful place in Rokarth.

The party’s path presents them with a maze of twisting, crumbling habways that wind their way far above hissing pits of industrial effluent. A fall here is potentially fatal. Local guides offer to show the characters the safest path for 20 solars each. Crossing without a guide requires each character to make a Routine (+20) Athletics (Climbing) Test. Failure causes them to slip along the path. Luckily, they fall onto a walkway further below and suffer [[/r 1d10]] Damage from the impact.

A successful Routine (+20) Intuition (Surroundings) or Awareness (Sight) Test reveals that the street ahead, curiously free of citizens but marked by recent blood stains, is being watched by a @UUID[Actor.jSJkugzVGrfqbl9o]{Skitarii Vanguard} from on high. The characters can pass safely by making a Challenging (+0) Stealth (Move Silently) Test. Failing this Test or the previous ones, the Vanguard calls in a patrol to investigate and follow the characters.

The characters stumble upon a code-locked Skitarii dataslate lying in the mud. A successful Hard (−20) Tech (Security) Test can unlock the dataslate, as can the data interface of any @UUID[Actor.vsiOALilPnEe3dKg]{Skitarri Vanguard Alpha}. The dataslate contains what the Skitarii know about the missing Tech-Priest, including the fact that intermittent transmissions from their implanted life-auger indicate they are still alive and somewhere in this sector of the Lower Hive.
